segments.he: גְּמָ׳ אָמַר רַבִּי יִרְמְיָה בַּר אַבָּא אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל: הַצָּד אֲרִי בְּשַׁבָּת — אֵינוֹ חַיָּיב עַד שֶׁיַּכְנִיסֶנּוּ לַגּוּרְזָקִי שֶׁלּוֹ.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» «Rabbi Yirmeya bar Abba said» that «Shmuel said: One who traps a lion on Shabbat is not liable» for trapping «unless he traps it in its cage,» and until that point it is not considered trapped.

moves.cueHe: אמר רבי ירמיה בר אבא אמר שמואל
moves.summary: Shmuel's ruling on trapping a lion, transmitted by R' Yirmeya bar Abba, glossing the preceding mishna on trapping
moves.about: liability for trapping a lion only once it is brought into its cage

edges.cueHe: אמר רבי ירמיה בר אבא אמר שמואל
edges.about: liability for trapping a lion only once it is brought into its cage

positions.claim: one who traps a lion is liable only once he brings it into its cage
positions.basis: until then it is not considered trapped
